Lemonade Slush
By: Michelle La Clair
Published: Wednesday, February 24, 2010 - 9:16am

Ingredients




2/3 cup frozen lemonade concentrate (partially thawed)
1 cup milk
2/3 cup water
1 teaspoon vanilla extract
12 crushed ice cubes
yellow food color (optional)

Preparation

1 In the blender combine the lemonade, milk, water, vanilla, and food color if desired. 2 Cover and process til blended. Slowly add ice cubes. Process til slushy. 3 Serve immediately.

About


A Summertime favorite!
